description_expanded: The spacious home features 4 bedrooms, 4 full baths, and 2 half baths with a large open Living/Dining room and fireplace. The first level offers a bedroom with private bath and provides access to the home’s gracious Courtyard and covered Loggia that features a Pool and summer kitchen. The first floor also offers a bonus sleeping room with 3 twin beds. The second level primary suite features a walk-in closet and large primary bath with separate soaking tub and walk-in shower. The additional 2nd level Guest Bedrooms overlook the Courtyard and Pool below. A Flex room on the second floor provides an additional TV viewing area. Parking for this home is located in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations. Pet Policy for this dog-friendly home -- We are pleased to welcome up to two well-mannered dogs (eighty pounds max per dog, please) per home, allowing your entire family—paws included—to enjoy the Alys Beach experience. For the comfort and safety of all guests, dogs must remain leashed in public spaces and be current on vaccinations. Kindly observe proper pet etiquette by cleaning up after your dog and utilizing the conveniently located waste stations throughout the community. Guests with more assertive dogs are encouraged to consider the use of a gentle muzzle in shared spaces, out of consideration for neighbors and fellow guests. Please note that dogs are not permitted on the beach – only Walton County residents may secure a dog permit for their furry friends. Many of our outdoor dining areas are pet-friendly; however, we recommend calling ahead to confirm individual merchant policies. Should you need local pet services—from dog walkers to veterinarians—our concierge is delighted to assist. A non-refundable pet fee of $350 applies.
